Title: 496261-2026: France – Civil engineering and building works – A7 - Valence crossing - Development of PS 681 and construction of a pedestrian and cycle footbridge
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a pedestrian and cyclist bridge – fundamentally very relevant for sbp. Location in France and lack of information on span/complexity slightly reduce the rating.
titel: A7 - Valence crossing - Rehabilitation of PS 681 and new construction of a pedestrian and cycle bridge
kurzbeschreibung: Rehabilitation of a road overpass and construction of a 55 m long pedestrian and cycle bridge.
umfang: Rehabilitation of the existing PS 681 structure with various repairs, replacement of safety barriers and addition of an architectural privacy screen. In addition, construction of a pedestrian and cycle bridge as a superstructure with embedded steel girders, 2 spans, usable width 3 m, length 55 m, with architectural privacy screen on both sides or alongside. Construction to be carried out under ongoing motorway traffic on the A7 and road traffic on Rue des Corsaires.
leistungen: Construction works for bridge rehabilitation and new bridge construction; renewal of bridge components; construction of a pedestrian bridge; execution under traffic.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Pedestrian and cycle bridges are fundamentally very relevant for sbp.
• New construction of a 55 m long bridge with 2 spans offers structural engineering relevance, even though construction works are being tendered here.
• Architectural privacy screen may indicate design ambition and a potential share of special structures.
• Execution under ongoing motorway and road traffic increases technical and logistical complexity.
• However, this is primarily a construction tender, not a classic planning or structural design services contract.
• Structural type and spans are rather conventional, therefore not of top-level relevance.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated in the tender. For a rough estimate, the following are relevant: 55 m long and 3 m wide pedestrian and cycle bridge with 2 spans, additional architectural privacy screen, rehabilitation of the existing PS 681, works under ongoing motorway and road traffic. From this, an overall volume in the low to mid single-digit million range could be conceivable, but it is not reliable enough for a numerical indication.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee information available. As construction works are being tendered and no separate designer’s fee is stated, no reliable fee for sbp can be derived.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability based on the economic and financial standing as well as the technical and professional capability and relevant experience required in the procurement documents. No specific minimum numbers or types of references are stated in the notice.
auftraggeber: AUTOROUTES DU SUD DE LA FRANCE (ASF), Direction Maîtrise d'Ouvrage Est, 1973 Boulevard de la Défense, Bâtiment Hydra - CS 10268, 92757 Nanterre Cedex, France, Contact: Direction Maîtrise d'Ouvrage Est, E-mail: ao.doie@vinci-autoroutes.com, Website: www.vinci-autoroutes.com
notes: Amendment notice to an open tender. Duration 15 months. Expected start of services December 2026. Electronic submission of tenders exclusively via https://consultations-asf.omnikles.com. Financing via co-financing agreement with ASF, Region Auvergne Rhône Alpes, Département Drôme and Valence Romans Agglomération.
